steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each territory is placed by its owner and its accounts against the coverage limit.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Account with no territory
findings.fix: Assign the account to a territory

findings.title: Territory over the coverage limit
findings.fix: Split the territory or add cover

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] accounts-unassigned.csv:12  Account with no territory.
       Fix: Assign the account to a territory.
[medium] terr-west.md:19  Territory over the coverage limit.
       Fix: Split the territory or add cover.
[low] terr-east.md:26  Territory with no owner.
       Fix: Assign an owner.
Not checked: Account relationships outside the file.
pros: Checks an account with no territory, a territory with no owner, and a territory whose accounts exceed the coverage limit in the plan.
cons: Not checked: Account relationships outside the file.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-sales-territory-plan skill on the records for this review.
